narrative: A clean sheet at the head of the Verona leaves. The pen has just come up. The page holds fourteen lines. Only two of them are set out here. No rule under them. No face. The same sheet. The pen is back in the horn. The space under the fourteen lines is bare.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the fourteen lines for his own mouth, and stopped.

entities.name: the lovers' play
entities.context: Shown on draft in Two lines, and the pen down
